title: 故事内容空洞，缺乏吸引力与深度
description: 故事内容平庸、乏味、自我中心，缺乏有趣的情节、背景信息和实质发展，无法吸引玩家。
evidence: just replace all gameplay elements - including story - with nothing
The subject matter was so banal that I spent the whole time waiting for a breaththrough that just doesn't happen.

evidence_items.quote: I felt unsafe, unclean, and grateful that Meiko never turned up to this unsettling evening.
evidence_items.description: 故事内容令人不适，无法产生共情
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我感到不安全、不干净，并且庆幸Meiko从未出现在这个令人不安的夜晚。

evidence_items.quote: there isn't even  a story!  It's a man giving monologue.
evidence_items.description: 游戏没有故事，只有独白
evidence_items.quote_zh: 甚至连故事都没有！只是一个男人在独白。

evidence_items.quote: there is no real context to the story line
evidence_items.description: 故事线缺乏真实背景
evidence_items.quote_zh: 故事情节没有任何真正的背景

evidence_items.quote: Oh he got stood up, that's the end of that arc, oh you can look at the stuff in the room, that's the end of the game.
evidence_items.description: 剧情线没有展开就结束了
evidence_items.quote_zh: 哦，他被放鸽子了，这条线就这么结束了；哦，你可以看看房间里的东西，游戏就这么结束了。

evidence_items.quote: i was waiting for a plot development. never came.
evidence_items.description: 等待剧情发展但始终没有出现
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我一直在等待情节发展。从未出现。

evidence_items.quote: The subject matter was so banal that I spent the whole time waiting for a breaththrough that just doesn't happen.
evidence_items.description: 题材平庸，没有突破
evidence_items.quote_zh: 主题如此平庸，以至于我全程都在等待一个根本不会发生的突破。

evidence_items.quote: Seriamente, perchè dovrebbe interessarmi una trama di questo tipo?
evidence_items.description: 剧情无聊，缺乏吸引力
evidence_items.quote_zh: 说真的，我为什么会对这种剧情感兴趣？

evidence_items.quote: the story and character have to be interesting and compelling. Eating bread and thinking about how much you must suck to get stood up?... Doesn't cut it
evidence_items.description: 故事和角色不有趣、不引人入胜
evidence_items.quote_zh: 故事和角色必须有趣且引人入胜。吃着面包，想着自己得有多差劲才会被人放鸽子？……这可不合格

evidence_items.quote: just replace all gameplay elements - including story - with nothing
evidence_items.description: 游戏移除了包括故事在内的所有玩法元素，没有任何内容替代
evidence_items.quote_zh: 把所有游戏元素——包括故事——都替换成虚无

evidence_items.quote: История совершенно не интригует, а главный герой не вызывает симпатии.
evidence_items.description: 故事完全不引人入胜，主角令人反感
evidence_items.quote_zh: 故事完全不引人入胜，而且主角也让人产生不了好感。

evidence_items.quote: oyunun amacı kız arkadaşınızı bekliyosunuz gelmiyor saçma sapan
evidence_items.description: 游戏目标是等女友但她不会来，情节荒诞
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的目的就是你在等你的女朋友，她不来，乱七八糟的

evidence_items.quote: сюжет - просто для лохов
evidence_items.description: 剧情很差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 剧情——纯粹是给傻子玩的

evidence_items.quote: без начала и конца
evidence_items.description: 故事没有开头和结尾
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有开头也没有结尾

evidence_items.quote: 話が自分よがりな内容
evidence_items.description: 故事内容自我中心
evidence_items.quote_zh: 故事内容自以为是

evidence_items.quote: a história é ruim pra caramba: você controla as reações de um cara que levou um bolo num jantar à dois e é obrigado a ouvir ele se lamentar e formular idéia sobre o motivo pelo qual levou o bolo.
evidence_items.description: 故事很差，全程只是听角色自怨自艾
evidence_items.quote_zh: 故事烂得要命：你控制一个在双人晚餐上被放鸽子的家伙的反应，还被迫听他哀叹，并琢磨自己为什么被放鸽子。

evidence_items.quote: whatever the creator was trying to convey in this story was lost in the pointless and mundane way they told it
evidence_items.description: 创作者想传达的故事信息在无意义和 mundane 的叙述中丢失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 无论创作者想在这个故事里传达什么，都被他们那种毫无意义又平淡乏味的讲述方式给弄丢了

evidence_items.quote: If its not the most interesting thing that happens to the character,  why aren't you telling the more interesting story?
evidence_items.description: 故事不是角色最有趣的经历
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果这不是发生在角色身上最有趣的事，那你为什么不讲那个更有趣的故事？

evidence_items.quote: No new information is gathered in each subsequent act and there is no real reason to have the game continue with no new information or insight.
evidence_items.description: 后续章节没有提供新信息或见解，缺乏继续游玩的理由。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在随后的每一幕中都没有收集到任何新信息，而且在没有新信息或新见解的情况下，游戏也没有真正的理由继续下去。

evidence_items.quote: No interesting story
evidence_items.description: 没有有趣的故事
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有有趣的故事

evidence_items.quote: even that falls flat after listening to him complain and talk about getting laid, ya it goes there oddly and near the end it just gets weird.
evidence_items.description: 角色独白内容变得奇怪，后期变得怪异
evidence_items.quote_zh: 即使那样，在听他抱怨和谈论上床之后也变得索然无味，是的，它奇怪地扯到了那上面，而且快到结尾时它就变得怪怪的了。

evidence_items.quote: The story is shallow
evidence_items.description: 故事内容浅薄
evidence_items.quote_zh: 故事很肤浅

evidence_items.quote: por último que la historia tuviera alguna suerte de profundidad
evidence_items.description: 故事缺乏深度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 至少故事能有点深度也好

evidence_items.quote: even the psychological exploration was limited
evidence_items.description: 心理探索内容有限
evidence_items.quote_zh: 就连心理探索也很有限

evidence_items.quote: story was disappointing at best
evidence_items.description: 故事令人失望
evidence_items.quote_zh: 故事充其量只能说是令人失望。

evidence_items.quote: A good start, but it lacked a climax. The story felt like it was just getting started 20 minutes in and then all of a sudden the credits rolled.
evidence_items.description: 故事缺乏高潮，感觉刚展开就结束了
evidence_items.quote_zh: 开头不错，但缺乏高潮。故事感觉才刚开始20分钟，然后突然就滚字幕了。

evidence_items.quote: I don't think the story is anything to write home about, and that is the main weakness of this game
evidence_items.description: 故事是游戏的主要弱点，没什么值得称道的
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我不觉得这个故事有什么值得大书特书的，而这正是这款游戏的主要弱点。

evidence_items.quote: Worse of all the story is so lame and pathetic.
evidence_items.description: 故事非常蹩脚可悲
evidence_items.quote_zh: 最糟糕的是，故事是如此蹩脚又可怜。

evidence_items.quote: a weak plot
evidence_items.description: 剧情薄弱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 薄弱的情节

evidence_items.quote: a crappy character
evidence_items.description: 角色塑造差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个糟糕的角色

evidence_items.quote: a plot filled with twists and turns (Will the Japanese girl show up? Will he resist the urge to get drunk and have a breakdown about poetry? (No))
evidence_items.description: 剧情缺乏实质转折
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个充满曲折的情节（那个日本妹子会出现吗？他能忍住不喝醉并因为诗歌而崩溃吗？（不能））

evidence_items.quote: a weak plot
evidence_items.description: 剧情薄弱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 薄弱的情节

evidence_items.quote: a plot filled with twists and turns (Will the Japanese girl show up? Will he resist the urge to get drunk and have a breakdown about poetry? (No))
evidence_items.description: 剧情缺乏实质转折
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个充满曲折的情节（那个日本妹子会出现吗？他能忍住不喝醉并因为诗歌而崩溃吗？（不能））
